title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Strawberry Razz lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elfliq Strawberry Razz Lemonade offers a brilliantly refreshing and perfectly balanced summer beverage experience. The profile expertly swirls the jammy sweetness of sun-ripened Strawberry and the sharp, slightly tart notes of Raspberry directly into a base of zesty, citrus-infused Lemonade. The result is a wonderfully crisp and vibrant vape from the first draw to the last. Blended to a versatile 50VG/50PG ratio, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is perfectly suited for both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping. It performs exceptionally well when paired with refillable pod kits and classic vape pens using coils rated between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. The use of high-quality nicotine salts ensures a wonderfully smooth throat hit alongside rapid, effective satisfaction. The Elfliq collection brings world-renowned flavour expertise to a convenient 10ml format. Produced to strict regulatory standards and available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium range allows you to experience intensely vivid and highly authentic fruit blends in your preferred refillable device.
